summary.prose: Building this Story teaches the JetBrains plugin's Model Tiers settings about the Claude-on-Ollama runner. The plugin's view of the daemon's definitions gains the host and hosting marks; the tier model then labels that runner's models cloud or local and says plainly when a configured model will not run; and the Check model dialog stops offering that runner. The JUnit tests reach the build gate through a small node bridge, as the earlier JetBrains story did.

tasks.title: host/hosting on the JetBrains definitions DTOs and their parsing; s5 gradle bridge
tasks.summary: jetbrains-plugin/src/main/kotlin/ai/insors/insrc/jetbrains/daemon/ModelDefinitions.kt: DefinedFamilyDto gains `host: String? = null` and DefinedModelDto gains `hosting: String? = null`; parseModelDefinitions reads them as non-blank strings. JUnit case in ModelDefinitionsGatewayTest.kt. A node bridge jetbrains-plugin/__tests__/b220-s5-gradle.test.ts (same pattern as s7-gradle.test.ts) runs the s5 JUnit cases for the build gate.
acceptanceChecks: An answer with a family host 'ollama' and models hosting 'cloud'/'local' parses them onto DefinedFamilyDto.host and DefinedModelDto.hosting.
An answer without host/hosting parses with null for both; existing parse behaviour (skipped malformed entries) is unchanged.
The bridge test runs the named JUnit case through gradle and passes.

tests.name: b220-s5-gradle.test.ts: ModelDefinitionsGatewayTest parses a family's host and its models' hosting, and null when the answer has neither

tasks.title: ModelTiersModel: cloud/local label, not-supported note and marker for a host family
tasks.summary: jetbrains-plugin/src/main/kotlin/ai/insors/insrc/jetbrains/settings/ModelTiersModel.kt: label() appends ' — cloud' / ' — local' from hosting; resolve() notes '<model> is not supported by <displayName> — the tier will not run' for a configured model a host family does not declare (vendor families keep the 'runs its default' note); ModelChoice.CurrentNotInCatalog gains `hosted: Boolean = false` and reads '(current, not supported): <id>' when set. JUnit cases in ModelTiersModelTest.kt over a fake answer with a host family, bridged in b220-s5-gradle.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: runnerOptions offers the host family next to today's; selectRunner to it takes its first declared model with effort ''; modelOptions lists only its declared models labelled '— cloud' / '— local'; effortOptions is '' plus the model's efforts (only '' for none); collectWrites writes the whole tier.
Vendor and plain Ollama model labels carry no cloud/local suffix.
A host model configured by alias resolves to its canonical id, labelled with its hosting.

A configured undeclared host-family model is noted 'not supported by <family> — the tier will not run', shown as '(current, not supported): <id>', and refused by unsavable; a vendor family keeps the 'runs its default' note and '(current, not listed)'; a host-less answer behaves as a vendor family.
A catalog snapshot holding a tier saved on the host family resolves to that runner, canonical model and effort with no note; an effort the model does not take is shown dropped.

tests.name: b220-s5-gradle.test.ts: ModelTiersModelTest offers the host family, labels its models cloud or local, offers efforts only where the model has them and writes the whole tier
b220-s5-gradle.test.ts: ModelTiersModelTest notes an undeclared host-family model as not supported, the tier will not run, while a vendor or host-less family keeps today's note
b220-s5-gradle.test.ts: ModelTiersModelTest resolves a tier saved on the host family to its runner, model and effort on reopen

tasks.title: ModelCheckFlow.families() excludes host families
tasks.summary: jetbrains-plugin/src/main/kotlin/ai/insors/insrc/jetbrains/settings/ModelCheckFlow.kt families() returns families with a cliKind and no host. JUnit case in ModelCheckFlowTest.kt, bridged in b220-s5-gradle.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: families() excludes the host family and keeps the vendor CLI families and their order.
With host absent (older daemon) the same family is offered.
